text:
ravi: Heads-up: after yesterday's perf canary, we need to reboard the v1 launch slice. P95 latency w/ KV cache is fine, but end-to-end tail on small tokens increased ~30% in multi-tenant mode. Not enough to block GA, but it changes customer promises.
tess: Yikes. Which customers does this materially affect?
ravI: (typo) ravi: Mostly customers on shared Dedicated pools — AcmeRetail, DataForge pilot. Single-tenant Dedicated unchanged.
omar: Root cause looks like a routing backpressure interaction with continuous batching. We can patch, but ETA is ~9 business days due to infra windows.
ivy: Product proposal: tighten launch success criteria + cut non-essential v1 features so we can preserve SLA for pilots. Suggest: 1) Ship with tenant isolation toggle (defaults to single-tenant for pilots) 2) Defer multi-tenant autoscale, fancy rollout controls, and analytics polish 3) Keep embeddings cache, model pinning, basic rate limits.
sam: Sales calls out: AcmeRetail needs multi-tenant throughput for their stress test next month. If we flip default to single-tenant, CS needs a migration plan and temporary credits for cost delta.
tess: Can we do an interim mitigation: flip to conservative batch sizing + disable the new routing heuristic, ship that as v1 conservative mode, then follow-up with optimized heuristic in v1.1? That costs CPU but protects latency.
omar: Yes that's viable. It'll reduce throughput by ~12% in best-case but should recover tail. Implementation is a 2-day change + canary.avi: Okay concrete cutlist I'm proposing (lock by EOD unless objections):
- Keep: embeddings cache, model pinning API, basic SLA checks, single-tenant and conservative multi-tenant mode
- Defer to v1.1: autoscale per-tenant, advanced rollout/A-B, analytics dashboard polish
- Customer mitigations: migration guide + temporary credit offer for AcmeRetail stress test
product-bot: schedule: scope-sync today 14:00 PT. Invites to @eng-runtime @customer-success @sales.
sam: I'll draft the migration + credits note and loop in legal for T&Cs.
omar: We'll prioritize conservative-mode patch and run perf canaries tomorrow AM.
tess: I'll update the roadmap card: shift v1 GA soft target +2 weeks and add a "conservative-mode" flag task. Link: https://confluence.redwood/v1-scope-adjust
ravi: Please flag any objections here before 17:00. If none, we'll publish the cutlist and notify pilots. :white_check_mark:
ivy: No objections from product-design.
omar: No infra objections; will push canary run earlier if needed.
sam: Noted, prepping customer comms.
product-bot: Decision logged: conservative-mode cut accepted pending customer comms.
